You maintain a house writing voice for engineering documents. A teammate asked for a short code-review comment in that voice on this topic: approving PR #4821 for the fictional ledger-reconcile service, which adds an idempotency key to the retry path.

The validator has already been run against the draft, and it printed exactly this:

```
format: code-review
pass/fail: FAIL (negative-list: 2 hits; structural gates: pass)
Structural signals:
  metric                    value    z       gate
  sentence length mean      14.2     -0.8    -
  sentence length variance  16.7     +2.6    -
  table density             0.00     -0.2    pass
  rhetorical-boldface       0.00     -0.1    pass
  title-case headings       0        -0.4    (non-gating)
  empty sections            0        -0.1    (non-gating)

Out of range: sentence length variance (z +2.6, target band +/-2.0)
Negative-list hits:
  L4: "moreover" (transition tell)
  L9: "It is worth noting that" (filler opener)
Layer 3 stances available in the profile: 'ship small deltas' (grounded), 'prefer boring solutions' (grounded), 'performance is a feature' (extrapolated)
```

The draft the validator scored is:

```
Solid work. It is worth noting that the retry path now carries an idempotency key, which removes the double-post window. Moreover, the tests cover the new branch. Approving.
```

Send the teammate your validation report for this draft.

section: - Follow the shape card's opening, heading, list, and ending rules. Imitate the exemplar's document shape -- its opening, headings, lists, and ending -- never its topic, wording, or sentence-level phrasing. Filling its sentence templates with new nouns is copying wording.

fixtures.application:
You maintain a house writing voice for long-form engineering documents. The profile's synthetic exemplar for the technical-writing format is below; it demonstrates the target document shape.

---
# Exemplar: Adding Circuit Breakers to the Payment Path

Every outage teaches the same lesson twice. We learn it when the pager fires, and again when we write the postmortem.

## Why now

- The payment path retries every failure, so one slow dependency becomes a queue of them.
- The dashboard already tells us which dependency is melting; we just never wired it to a breaker.

## The change

We add a breaker around the retry loop. It counts consecutive failures and opens after five.

## What we are not doing

- No new deploy tooling. The breaker ships as a library change.
- No automatic rollback. A human still closes the loop.

None of this is exotic. It is a counter with a policy attached.
---

Write a new technical-writing document in this voice for a different topic: introducing a read replica for the fictional catalog-api service so reporting queries stop hitting the primary. The only names available are the ones in this request.

When the report includes the Delta number, label it `informational` and stop there: no match-quality adjective, and no clause where the Delta number is the reason the draft counts as in voice.

Report the number and never present it as vouching for the draft: if a sentence says or implies that the Delta value shows, indicates, or suggests the draft matches the voice, cut that clause before delivering.
